sailing_access_coverage.scope: Exact publisher IDs and departure dates from observed public sitemap URLs, or retained/reviewed exact seller pages. Link discovery is not live-price or inventory verification.

archive.coverage_note: Prices recovered from available archive captures. No values estimated for missing months. Current availability and final costs require a quote.

offers.title: All-Inclusive campaign through 2027
offers.summary: Advisor promotion body lists complimentary All-Inclusive and reduced deposits for new bookings by 17 November 2026. Specific UK rate eligibility remains unconfirmed.
offers.next_action: Obtain a current UK quote for the exact sailing and cabin, with the promotion itemised.

offers.title: Card-partner benefits: verify the UK programme
offers.summary: US Amex material names Windstar; the retrieved UK partner list does not establish Windstar inclusion. Do not transfer US eligibility or assume a card is held.
offers.next_action: Confirm Windstar participation directly in applicable UK card-provider terms before comparing an Amex quote with an independent agent.

offers.title: Canada-resident extra savings
offers.summary: Public promotion is expressly restricted to Canadian residents. It cannot be applied to a UK-resident new booking.
offers.next_action: Obtain a current UK quote for the exact sailing and cabin, with the promotion itemised.

offers.title: 2028 Europe launch benefits: recheck terms
offers.summary: Indexed advisor copy mentions All-Inclusive, $100 per guest and 5% pay-in-full savings with 31 October 2026 cutoff. Opened page version omitted that section; keep as an unresolved lead.
offers.next_action: Obtain a current UK quote for the exact sailing and cabin, with the promotion itemised.

offers.title: Archived Sail Beyond Ordinary offer
offers.summary: The public terms explicitly expire on 17 November 2024. Retained as a rejected example to prevent future false alerts.
offers.next_action: Obtain a current UK quote for the exact sailing and cabin, with the promotion itemised.

offers.title: Existing agency-held group allocation
offers.summary: Public group pages describe negotiated rates, but the detail page includes old May 2026 availability wording and exclusions against Alumni/Welcome Home. Existing UK-held cabins require an agency quote.
offers.next_action: Find an agency with a named existing allocation; verify UK sale, final price, allotment release date and benefit combinations.

offers.title: Onboard booking offer
offers.summary: Advisor page advertises an additional 10%, $100 credit per person and Yacht Club benefits; two public pages disagree on minimum deposit. Welcome Home is excluded. Confirm current UK terms onboard.
offers.next_action: Ask the onboard consultant for a written UK quote, deposit, exact exclusions and agent-price comparison. Do not add 10% and 5% automatically.

offers.title: Returning-guest fare reduction
offers.summary: Public Yacht Club material describes a 5% fare reduction. Confirm exclusions and whether it is already included in an agent quote.
offers.next_action: Obtain a current UK quote for the exact sailing and cabin, with the promotion itemised.
